lines.text: Every banana you eat is radioactive.
Bananas are full of potassium. And a tiny bit of natural potassium is radioactive. It's called potassium-40.
One banana gives you about 0.1 microsieverts.
And it doesn't build up.  Your body keeps its potassium steady, and flushes out the extra.
Scientists even joke about it as a unit: the Banana Equivalent Dose.
Send this to the friend who eats three a day. Because remember…
